questions.prompt: What should production code assume about LLM output?
options: It may be wrong and needs validation/evaluation
questions.answer: It may be wrong and needs validation/evaluation
questions.explanation: LLM APIs are probabilistic and can hallucinate. Production systems need validation, evals, fallback, and monitoring.

concept_panel.title: LLM APIs
concept_panel.explanation: LLM APIs are probabilistic and can hallucinate. Production systems need validation, evals, fallback, and monitoring.
concept_panel.practical_example: Validate an AI-generated KPI recommendation before showing it as final.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand AI reliability.

options: Representing text meaning as vectors for similarity search
questions.answer: Representing text meaning as vectors for similarity search
questions.explanation: Embeddings map content into vector space so related meanings can be found by similarity.

concept_panel.title: Embeddings
concept_panel.explanation: Embeddings map content into vector space so related meanings can be found by similarity.
concept_panel.practical_example: Embed support docs and search for chunks relevant to a user question.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you know AI retrieval basics.

questions.explanation: Vector databases index embeddings for nearest-neighbor retrieval.

concept_panel.title: Vector Databases
concept_panel.explanation: Vector databases index embeddings for nearest-neighbor retrieval.
concept_panel.practical_example: Find portfolio Q&A examples closest to a chat query.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand retrieval infrastructure.

questions.prompt: What does RAG add to an LLM flow?
questions.explanation: RAG grounds answers in retrieved documents or examples, useful for changing/private knowledge.

concept_panel.title: RAG
concept_panel.explanation: RAG grounds answers in retrieved documents or examples, useful for changing/private knowledge.
concept_panel.practical_example: Retrieve schema notes before answering a dashboard intelligence question.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can reduce hallucination through architecture.

questions.prompt: What is a good prompt engineering goal?
options: Constrain task, context, format, and refusal behavior
questions.answer: Constrain task, context, format, and refusal behavior
questions.explanation: Prompts should specify role, task, constraints, source use, output format, and fallback behavior.

concept_panel.title: Prompt Engineering
concept_panel.explanation: Prompts should specify role, task, constraints, source use, output format, and fallback behavior.
concept_panel.practical_example: Ask the model to answer only from retrieved KPI metadata.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can shape AI behavior deliberately.

options: They constrain context size, cost, and latency
questions.answer: They constrain context size, cost, and latency
questions.explanation: Token limits force context selection and summarization. More tokens usually cost more and add latency.

concept_panel.title: Token Limits
concept_panel.explanation: Token limits force context selection and summarization. More tokens usually cost more and add latency.
concept_panel.practical_example: Chunk and retrieve only relevant documents instead of sending everything.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand model runtime constraints.

questions.explanation: Streaming sends partial output as it is generated. It helps UX but does not solve factuality.

concept_panel.title: Streaming
concept_panel.explanation: Streaming sends partial output as it is generated. It helps UX but does not solve factuality.
concept_panel.practical_example: A chat UI can show tokens as they arrive.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you separate UX latency from answer quality.

questions.prompt: What is a practical AI cost control?
options: Limit context, cache safe results, and choose model size by evals
questions.answer: Limit context, cache safe results, and choose model size by evals
questions.explanation: AI cost depends on model, tokens, traffic, retries, and caching. Optimize with measurement and quality gates.

concept_panel.title: Cost Optimization
concept_panel.explanation: AI cost depends on model, tokens, traffic, retries, and caching. Optimize with measurement and quality gates.
concept_panel.practical_example: Use a smaller model for classification and a stronger one for complex generation.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can run AI features economically.

questions.prompt: What is the core storage design for a URL shortener?
options: Map short codes to long URLs with collision handling
questions.answer: Map short codes to long URLs with collision handling
questions.explanation: URL shorteners test key generation, redirects, storage, TTLs, analytics, and collision handling.

concept_panel.title: URL Shortener
concept_panel.explanation: URL shorteners test key generation, redirects, storage, TTLs, analytics, and collision handling.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can design a simple scalable service.

questions.prompt: What must a chat API usually manage?
options: Conversation state, auth, rate limits, streaming, and persistence
questions.answer: Conversation state, auth, rate limits, streaming, and persistence
questions.explanation: Chat APIs combine HTTP/WebSocket/SSE behavior with state, moderation, cost, and latency concerns.

concept_panel.title: Chat API
concept_panel.explanation: Chat APIs combine HTTP/WebSocket/SSE behavior with state, moderation, cost, and latency concerns.
concept_panel.practical_example: Store conversation IDs and stream assistant output.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can design interactive APIs.

questions.prompt: Why use a queue in a notification service?
options: To decouple send requests from provider delivery
questions.answer: To decouple send requests from provider delivery
questions.explanation: Notifications involve templates, channels, provider failures, retries, idempotency, and user preferences.

concept_panel.title: Notification Service
concept_panel.explanation: Notifications involve templates, channels, provider failures, retries, idempotency, and user preferences.
concept_panel.practical_example: Queue email/SMS jobs and process with workers.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand async delivery systems.

questions.prompt: What should an AI API expose besides the answer?
options: Status, errors, usage/cost metadata, and traceable behavior
questions.answer: Status, errors, usage/cost metadata, and traceable behavior
questions.explanation: AI APIs need normal API discipline plus model-specific observability, rate limits, and safety behavior.

concept_panel.title: AI API
concept_panel.explanation: AI APIs need normal API discipline plus model-specific observability, rate limits, and safety behavior.
concept_panel.practical_example: Return answer plus retrieved source IDs and token usage.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can productionize AI endpoints.

coding_challenges.title: EPAM AI and System Design status classifier
coding_challenges.instructions: Implement classify_status_code(code: int) -> str. Return success for 200-299, redirect for 300-399, client_error for 400-499, server_error for 500-599, and unknown otherwise.
coding_challenges.explanation: The challenge reinforces deterministic branching, status-code categories, and local test execution.
